newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AC MILAN OUTGUN AJAX IN EURO SIX-A-SIDE FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AC MILAN OUTGUN AJAX IN EURO SIX-A-SIDE FINAL.

text.p: AC Milan, suffering one of their worst seasons for many years, salvaged a minor consolation on Tuesday when they crushed Ajax Amsterdam 6-2 in the final of the "Euro 6ix's" six-a-side tournament.

Bundled out of the European Cup after a home defeat by Norway's Rosenborg and after showing erratic domestic form, Milan's stars unsettled Ajax right from the start and three goals in the dying minutes gave them a comfortable victory and the $200,000 winners cheque.

Despite boasting the attacking flair of former World Player of the Year Roberto Baggio, Milan's success in the tournament was built around a strategy of defending tightly and catching their opponents on the break.
Milan went 2-0 up with two lucky breaks, Baggio scoring the opener amid confusion when there were two balls on the pitch and then Overmars deflected an Edgar Davids' cross into his own goal.

Ajax hit back with two goals inside a minute from Richard Witschge and Frank de Boer which brought the 20,000 home crowd alive. However, a curled corner from Baggio found its way in and in the last quarter Pietro Vierchewood, Edgar Davids and Dejan Savicevic all scored as Ajax threw their players forward in desperation.
Baggio was named best player of the tournament as well as being joint top scorer with five goals.
In the play-off for third place, Glasgow Rangers beat Liverpool in a one-on-one shoot-off after the match ended 3-3.
